# anthropic_invite (Resource)

Invites a person to the organization by email. Works with `admin_api_key`/`oauth_token` (Console organizations) and `enterprise_api_key` (Claude Enterprise organizations).

Invites have no update endpoint, so every change forces a new invite. Once accepted or expired the invite stays in state with its final `status`; destroy is a no-op for anything other than a pending invite. To resend an expired invite, taint or replace the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anthropic_invite" "jane" {
  email = "jane@example.com"
  role  = "developer"
}

# Claude Enterprise organizations can pre-assign RBAC groups.
resource "anthropic_invite" "contractor" {
  email          = "contractor@example.com"
  role           = "user"
  rbac_group_ids = [anthropic_rbac_group.contractors.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address to invite.
- `role` (String) Organization role: `user`, `developer`, `billing`, `claude_code_user` (Console) or `user`, `managed` (Claude Enterprise).

### Optional

- `rbac_group_ids` (List of String) RBAC groups to add the user to on acceptance. Claude Enterprise only.

### Read-Only

- `accepted_at` (String) Acceptance timestamp; null until accepted.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Invite id (`invite_...`).
- `invited_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `status` (String) `pending`, `accepted`, `expired` or `deleted`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import anthropic_invite.jane invite_01ExampleInviteId00000000
```
